brainstorm: Achieved: Batch visual and layout extraction of all 31 study PDFs with non-standard character cleaning, automated reference stripping, and high-fidelity VLM-generated figure descriptions. Next steps: 1. Set up the evaluation loop processing the 31 unified markdowns through selected LLMs. 2. Implement the prompt compilation step merging the unified markdown with the target instruction and glossary templates. 3. Manage model cards (Ollama/LMS/Cloud endpoints) and save output evaluations to JSON. 4. Populate evaluation tables with NaN placeholders for missing parameters to avoid false zeros.
